summary: Iteration 58 - Web Frontend Cuadre System Testing. All core features WORKING. Tested: login flow, navigation to /cuadre, sellers list (26 sellers), cuadre detail breakdown (Venta Total, Comisión, Premios, Ganancia Neta), date filter, close cuadre modal, settlement history, and vendedor role restriction.

issues: Minor: Vendedor can navigate directly to /cuadre via URL but sees empty state (0 vendedores) because API returns 403. Backend protection is correct, but frontend could add role-based redirect for better UX.

critical_code_review_comments: Cuadre page correctly shows breakdown: Venta Total, Comisión (%), Premios Pagados, Ganancia Neta
Formula verified: Ganancia Neta = Ventas - Comisión - Premios (commission ALWAYS deducted)
Date filter working - can filter by date range
Close cuadre modal working - payment recorded, balance updated correctly
Settlement history showing all records with correct data
Vendedor role correctly hidden from Cuadre menu in dashboard
Backend correctly returns 403 for vendedor on all settlement endpoints

success_rate.backend: 100% - All settlement endpoints verified (403 for vendedor, 200 for admin)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 new settlement record during testing (RD$ 50 payment)
